title: Connectome-wide dysconnectivity signature tracks clinical status in major depressive disorder
abstract: Nature Mental Health, Published online: 21 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s44220-026-00747-w Using polyconnectomic scores in Japanese and German cohorts, the authors demonstrate that a whole-brain functional connectivity pattern in depression generalizes across diverse populations, distinguishing individuals with depression from healthy controls and correlates with symptom severity, particularly anhedonia.
